formattedAddress: 105, Taiwan, Taipei City, Songshan District, Zhongzheng Village, Section 3, Nanjing E Rd, 275號2樓

text.text:
不荤主义者 Taipei offers one of the most thoughtfully crafted plant-based dining experiences in the city. It's the Ding Tai Febg Vegetarian/Vegan heaven!

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels calm, warm, and intentionally minimalist! It's perfect for settling into a slow, lingering dinner.

The menu focuses on clean, well-balanced flavors w all nature ingredients, and each dish feels like it’s designed to highlight ingredients at their best. Presentation is elegant without being pretentious, and the portions strike a nice balance between satisfying and not overly filling.

Service is attentive in a low-key, unobtrusive way. Staff are knowledgeable about the dishes and happy to offer suggestions based on your preferences, which adds a personal touch to the meal! Highly recommend this place!!

text.text:
I’d visited the Veggienius branch in Taichung before, so when my friends suggested lunch at their Taipei location, I was excited to see how it compared. Making a reservation was incredibly easy, you can book directly through Google in just a few taps.

The restaurant is close to MRT Exit 6, though the entrance is a little easy to miss since you have to go up a flight of stairs. Once you’re inside, the space opens up nicely. It’s roomy, the atmosphere feels calm, and the seating is arranged in a way that gives each table a comfortable amount of privacy.

The food was just as tasty as I remembered, flavorful, well-prepared, and served quickly. The staff were attentive and friendly. The menu is mostly vegetarian with some vegan options; I only wish they offered a few more vegan variations because the dishes they do have are great.

One thing to keep in mind: they’re cash only, so be sure to bring some with you.

P.s. if you write a review, you get a VIP card for future discounts

GOOD SERVICE 🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡
GREAT FOOD 💛💛💛💛

There was a bit of a messy queue when we arrived from the lift, as I brought my elderly parents to eat. Luckily, my local friend had made a reservation in advance, so we didn’t have to wait.

My plum drink unfortunately had a fly in it when I was almost finished. (●~●)
The staff offered to replace it right away but i rejected because I am full too ^v^.

Overall, they truly serve the best food and provide excellent service to their customers! 🌟

We will be back if we come to 🇹🇼 next time.

text.text:
Delicious vegetarian dumplings!!!! My favourite is the xiao long bao and guo tie. Thin dumpling skin. Better than most meat dumplings around. It's so easy to be a vegetarian in Taiwan. Abundance of good selections. Love it!
Located on the 2nd floor, you have to take the lift up. The restraunt is bright and toilet is clean. They do have a 90 minute cap per table.
Also, no alcohol is allowed.

text.text:
An exceptional dining experience that far exceeded expectations. Compliments to the chef for the thoughtful and creative execution—both 淡淡的幸福 and 口水鸡丝 were beautifully crafted and memorable. The meal concluded on a high note with the Mango Panna Cotta, a delightful and refreshing finish. We thoroughly enjoyed every dish and left feeling truly satisfied.

The experience would be further elevated with a warmer, more welcoming service and slightly dimmer lighting to create a cozier ambience.
